questions.question: What is the correct sequence of the 5 critical steps of any Machine Learning project?
options: Training, Problem definition, Data collection, Evaluation, Coding
Problem definition, Data collection, Data preparation, Model training, Evaluation
Data collection, Coding, Uploading, Testing, Pushing
Importing libraries, Calling APIs, Building forms, Showing plots, Printing outputs
questions.explanation: Spot on! The standard data science workflow goes from defining the problem, gathering data, cleaning/preparing it, training the algorithm, to evaluating final accuracy.

questions.question: What does the essential data science golden rule 'Garbage In, Garbage Out' mean?
options: You must delete your code files when you get an error
If you feed the model low-quality, noisy, or badly labeled training data, the predictions will be completely inaccurate
Webcams require clean glass lenses to capture faces
The computer will run out of storage space if you store too many photos
questions.explanation: Amazing! AI models only learn from what we show them. If our training data has errors or messy labeling, the trained model will perform poorly.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered a primary method of Data Collection in machine learning workflows?
options: Finding pre-made datasets online, using public datasets, or drawing/capturing your own custom examples
Only importing standard libraries like math
questions.explanation: Excellent! Data collection is flexible: we can leverage existing data sources online or capture custom images manually.

questions.question: In our custom drawing dataset on ML for Kids, how many coordinate images did we collect for each class bucket (Heart, Star, Flower)?
questions.explanation: Great! We collected 15 custom drawings per class to provide the classification model with enough representative examples of shape features.

questions.question: Simple Coding Task: Write a Python statement to define a dictionary named 'shapes_count' with the keys 'Heart' and 'Star' set to the integer value 15, and print it.
questions.explanation: Outstanding! Using dictionaries to record dataset distributions is standard practice in data analysis.

questions.question: Simple Coding Task: Write a Python statement to print the string: 'Data collection step complete!'.
questions.explanation: Perfect! Marking the completion of lifecycle phases helps in tracking complex automated training workflows.
